title: Percentage Change Calculator
h1: Percentage Change Calculator — Increase or Decrease
seoTitle: Free Percentage Change Calculator — From Old to New Value
description: Calculate the percentage increase or decrease between two numbers. See the absolute change and the percentage difference instantly. Free and private.
intro: Enter an original value and a new value to see the percentage change and the absolute difference.
blurb: Calculate percentage increase or decrease between two values.
howItWorks: Click Calculate to see the percentage change and absolute difference.
examples: Useful for price changes, growth rates or score improvements.

faq.a: (new - old) / old * 100. Positive means increase, negative means decrease.

faq.q: What if the original value is zero?
faq.a: Percentage change is undefined when the starting value is zero. The tool will show a message.
